_comment: LifegainHeliodCombo (2026-10-27), Abiding Grace: TWO COPIES = two triggers, each its own mode and target. Two Soul Wardens in the graveyard are two legal targets (copies of one card), Auriok Champion (sick) on the battlefield. Trigger 1 returns a Warden (Champion +1 = 21); trigger 2 returns the OTHER Warden (Champion +1, and the first Warden sees it enter +1 = 23). 21 or 22 = the second trigger re-targeted the first's card (fizzle) or gained instead.
